seo_title: Can You Buy Your Lease and Sell It? Plus Turn-In Damage and Bad Credit
takeaways: Equity is only real after taxes and fees: subtract everything first.
Turn-in damage has three answers: pay it, fix it, or buy the car. Price all three.
A credit setback doesn't end the conversation: clean up your reports and compare total cost.
